propositions: the review-bot service must route all LLM calls through Bedrock inference profiles instead of direct Anthropic API, with per-pass model class slots (opus for base/finder passes, sonnet for verify/coach passes) preserved across providers

the production gate must fail closed with no cross-provider fallback when Bedrock becomes unavailable, enforced through missing import guards and kill-switch recovery to direct Anthropic via environment variable revert

the Bedrock deployment requires container packaging changes (bedrock extra installation), AWS region configuration (already present), and IAM permissions (already granted), with no Anthropic credential retirement because the shared .env and opcert dependency retain that credential by design

a CloudWatch alarm must observe Bedrock client-error rates using AWS-native metrics (InvocationClientErrors/Invocations dimensioned by ModelId), independent of the host-published voter-error alarm, to surface Bedrock degradation that still produces votes

the cutover is ordered: recovery path proven (kill switch and alarms in parent commit, induced VOTER_ERROR observed on Anthropic path pre-cutover), then provider flip takes effect (class slots set), then post-cutover validation (real vote on Bedrock, usage log tally, drill recovery)

all Bedrock transient-fault handling must use botocore stock client defaults without custom retry envelopes, since bedrock_model.py does not configure RetryConfig unlike the Anthropic path, making llm_retry_max_attempts and timeout_s inapplicable to this provider
